originalTitle: Fenix Flexin isn’t even denying using AI to make ‘Rubberz’ anymore

content: It took long enough, but now LA rapper Fenix Flexin appears to have admitted using AI for the 80s synth pop-themed song “Rubberz.” His comments follow the producer Medasin’s videos claiming that an AI tool called Treblo (formerly Sonauto) was used to make the song, and the company releasing an AI detector that identifies it as Treblo AI-created. In a reply to a comment pointing out that Tyga admitted to relying on AI for his own controversial ’80s-influenced album $tarface, on one of his Instagram posts, Fenix said: > never said I didn’t use AI , i said it had nun to do w recording process . I didn’t even know what da app was till we mixed it and erbody started commenting . ain’t nothing wrong w using new technology as a tool keep up w the times or get left behind The comment insists he never denied using AI, but last month on Hot 97’s Mornings With Mero when asked directly about AI use by interviewer Kazeem Famuyide, he stated clearly that there’s “no AI on it.” [Media: https://youtu.be/P9UWXE8pk0Y?si=DtnPbXty7IvH-BL3&t=52] He’s repeatedly gone out of his way to try and dispel the AI allegations publicly since the song was released, despite what he says now. Fenix and his team have posted what they claimed were clips of the recording session files, popped into the comments to insist the song was made by two humans recording in his living room with “pro tools auto tune and some reverb,” and said he’s actually singing in clips where it looks like he’s lip syncing. [Image: I suppose technically AI had nothing to do with the recording process if the song was generated. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-07-at-11.53.08-AM.png?quality=90&strip=all] [Media: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/fzkoENoDrbs]
chineseTitle: Fenix Flexin 甚至不再否认使用 AI 来制作“Rubberz”
chineseSummary: 虽然花了很长时间，但现在洛杉矶说唱歌手 Fenix Flexin 似乎承认在 80 年代合成流行音乐主题歌曲“Rubberz”中使用了人工智能。在他发表评论之前，制作人 Medasin 的视频声称使用了一种名为 Treblo（以前称为 Sonauto）的 AI 工具来制作这首歌，并且该公司发布了一个识别它的 AI 探测器 [...]
chineseContent: 虽然花了很长时间，但现在洛杉矶说唱歌手 Fenix Flexin 似乎承认在 80 年代合成流行音乐主题歌曲“Rubberz”中使用了人工智能。在他发表评论之前，制作人 Medasin 的视频声称使用了名为 Treblo（以前称为 Sonauto）的 AI 工具来制作这首歌，并且该公司发布了一个 AI 检测器，将其识别为 Treblo AI 创建的。在回复指出 Tyga 承认依赖人工智能来制作自己备受争议的 80 年代影响的专辑 $tarface 的评论时，Fenix 在他的 Instagram 帖子中说道： > 从未说过我没有使用人工智能，我说过它有修女来完成录音过程。我什至不知道这个应用程序是什么，直到我们混合它并且每个人都开始评论。使用新技术作为工具并没有错，跟上时代的步伐，否则就会落后。该评论坚称他从未否认使用人工智能，但上个月在 Hot 97 的 Mornings With Mero 节目中，当采访者 Kazeem Famuyide 直接问及人工智能的使用时，他明确表示“其中没有人工智能”。 [媒体：https://youtu.be/P9UWXE8pk0Y?si=DtnPbXty7IvH-BL3&t=52] 自从这首歌发布以来，他一再竭尽全力试图公开消除对人工智能的指控，尽管他现在说了些什么。菲尼克斯和他的团队发布了他们声称是录音会话文件的剪辑，并在评论中坚称这首歌是由两个人在他的客厅里用“专业工具自动调音和一些混响”录制的，并表示他实际上在剪辑中唱歌，看起来像是对口型。 [图片：我认为从技术上讲，如果歌曲是生成的，人工智能与录制过程无关。 https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-07-at-11.53.08-AM.png?quality=90&strip=all] [媒体：https://www.youtube.com/shorts/fzkoENoDrbs]
